subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Tue Aug 4 shortlist | Mega-cap earnings continuation (GOOGL, AMZN) leads a clean 5-name list
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Tuesday, August 4, 2026 — Kuwait time

Candidates Found

5 cleared all gates

Cut

14 names

Same-week Q2 earnings beats + guidance raises (7/31) are the whole story today — GOOGL, AMZN, SPXC, AXTI and NWL all confirmed real, live continuation on IBKR. Several other headline "movers" (META, PYPL, MANH, HYFM) turned out to be faded or reversing when checked against live data — see the cut list.

Scan coverage

26 web searches across all lanes (technical, flow, earnings-reaction, sector-agnostic, large cap) + IBKR topic discovery. ~22 raw tickers surfaced; 5 survived all 4 gates. Mix: 2 mega cap, 1 mid-large cap, 1 small-mid cap, 1 small cap — good cap-size balance, no padding needed.

Momentum Shortlist

#1 — GOOGL Alphabet Inc. ★★★★☆ 4/5

Communication Services · MEGA CAP

Signal: Q2 earnings beat 7/30 after close — Cloud revenue +82% YoY to $24.8B, FY26 capex guidance raised to $195–205B. Gapped $333.66→$356.13 (+5.8%) on 7/31 (1.7x avg volume), continued to $373.51 close on 8/3 (+4.9% further, 24.4M shares). 2 trading days ago, still intact.

Why it's interesting: Durable multi-quarter thesis (accelerating Cloud growth + raised capex), not a one-time beat. Least extended of the mega-cap pair — still 8.3% below its actual 52-week high ($408.61), so real room remains vs. AMZN which is already trading above its prior high.

Price: $374.62 (IBKR live, +0.30% today) Avg $ vol: ~$8.9B/day
RS vs SPY: +12% over 3 sessions vs. SPX roughly flat — clearly outperforming

Target: +5–9% over 5–8 trading days, toward the $408.61 52-week high.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET defensible — least-extended of the group. Prefer scaling on any dip to $365–368.

Event window: Q2 earnings already behind ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified Defense check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze GOOGL
#2 — AMZN Amazon.com Inc. ★★★★☆ 4/5

Consumer Discretionary / Cloud · MEGA CAP

Signal: Q2 beat, crossed $3T market cap, best margins in 2+ years. Gapped $235.50→$271.58 (+15.3%) on 7/31 (78M shares, ~4x avg), continued to $284.02 close 8/3 (+4.6% further, 52.6M shares). Fired 7/31, 2 trading days ago.

Why it's interesting: Cleanest large-cap post-earnings continuation shape — the binary event is fully behind it, liquidity is essentially unlimited. Caveat: already up 19.6% in 3 sessions and trading above its own prior 52-week high — genuinely extended right now.

Price: $280.79 (IBKR live, −1.14% today) Avg $ vol: ~$14B/day
RS vs SPY: +19.6% over 3 sessions vs. SPX flat — massively outperforming

Target: +4–7% over 3–6 trading days — trim expectations given the extension.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $271–275 (7/31 close / 8/3 open zone) — chasing at $280 after a 19.6% 3-day run is poor R:R; that zone restores a clean stop reference below the breakout level.

Event window: Q2 earnings already behind ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified Defense check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze AMZN
#3 — SPXC SPX Technologies Inc. ★★★☆☆ 3/5 ⭐ BEST ENTRY STRUCTURE

Industrials — HVAC / Detection & Measurement · MID-LARGE CAP

Signal: Q2 adj. EPS $2.02 vs $1.85 consensus, revenue $679M vs $640M consensus, raised FY26 EPS/revenue/EBITDA guidance on data-center demand + Detection & Measurement strength. Gapped $199.30→$219.62 (+10.2%) on 7/31, pulled back to $214.13 close 8/3 (−2.5%, still above pre-earnings level). Fired 7/31, 2 trading days ago.

Why it's interesting: The only name in this list NOT sitting at/near session highs. It gapped, then cooled 9.6% off the spike high while holding well above pre-earnings levels — the textbook "let it settle, then enter" shape Gate 4 is built to reward, instead of a chase.

Price: $214.13 (last IBKR tick) Avg $ vol: ~$80–160M/day
RS vs SPY: +7.4% net over 3 sessions vs. flat market — outperforming

Target: +8–11% over 5–10 trading days, back toward the 7/31 intraday high $236.89 and beyond.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET reasonable — real pullback in progress, not a chase.

Event window: Q2 earnings already behind ✅

Halal: ⚠️ Unverified core mix Defense check: ✅ Clear

Diversified industrial (HVAC + Detection & Measurement instrumentation). No defense contracts surfaced in research and the core business reads clean, but do a quick gut-check before entering given the mixed segment structure.

Sizing note: $214/share requires fractional shares for a ~$82–98 position (0.38–0.46 sh) — fractional confirmed working per the IQV fill.

Next step: analyze SPXC
#4 — AXTI AXT Inc. ★★★☆☆ 3/5

Semiconductors — substrate materials · SMALL CAP

Signal: Q2 revenue $47.6M vs $34.1M expected, EPS $0.19 vs $0.07 expected — record indium phosphide revenue on AI/data-center optics demand. $46.94 close 7/30 → $60.43 close 7/31 (+28.7%, 19.7M shares, ~4-6x avg) → $68.67 close 8/3 (+13.6% further, 11.9M shares) → +1.83% further today.

Why it's interesting: Real fundamentals (AI/data-center demand for optical-transceiver substrates), confirmed on heavy volume all three days, still grinding to new highs today rather than fading. But +49% in 3 sessions is a name to let cool, not chase.

Price: $69.93 (IBKR live, +1.83% today) Avg $ vol: $700M–1.4B/day (elevated)
RS vs SPY: +49% over 3 sessions — enormous outperformance

Target: +5–8% continuation only if entering — do not chase the full move already made.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $58–63 (7/31 close / 8/3 open zone). If it doesn't pull back, this is one to watch, not force.

Event window: Q2 earnings already behind ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified Defense check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze AXTI
#5 — NWL Newell Brands Inc. ★★★☆☆ 3/5

Consumer Products (Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Coleman, Graco) · SMALL-MID CAP

Signal: Q2 beat + raised FY26 guidance. $5.14 close 7/30 → intraday spike to $7.13 then closed $5.60 on 7/31 (+8.9% net, big same-day give-back) → $6.36 close 8/3 (+13.6% further, closing only 4.2% off the day's $6.64 high — real continuation, not a fade).

Why it's interesting: Turnaround consumer name up +23.7% over 2 sessions with the second day closing near its high — genuine follow-through after the volatile first-day spike-and-fade.

Price: $6.36 (last IBKR tick) Avg $ vol: ~$130–140M/day
RS vs SPY: +23.7% over 2 sessions — strongly outperforming

Target: +8–12% over 5–8 trading days, back toward/through the 7/31 intraday high $7.13.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET reasonable near $6.36, or scale in on a dip to $6.00–6.10.

Important: 7/31 shows this name can move violently intraday (gap to $7.13, close $5.60 same day) — a stop-limit, never a plain stop, below $5.90 is essential.

Event window: Q2 earnings already behind ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: Sub-$10 stock, whole shares easy. ~$2 round-trip commission on an ~$82 position (13 sh) is ~2.4% drag — the +8–12% target clears that comfortably.

Next step: analyze NWL

🏆 Today's best setup

SPXC — SPX Technologies

Every other name on this list is sitting at or near its post-earnings high — a chase. SPXC is the one that's already given back 9.6% of its spike while holding well above pre-earnings levels, which is exactly the "cooled off, real entry" shape this strategy is built to find instead of forcing an extended breakout. Real fundamentals behind it (guidance raise, data-center-driven demand), genuine liquidity, and 8-11% of room back to the spike high without needing a blue-sky re-rating.

Invalidation: a daily close back below $211 (the 8/3 low) — that would mean the post-earnings pullback has turned into an actual breakdown, not a healthy cool-off. That's the stop reference, not a percentage guess.

Runner-up for max liquidity/quality: GOOGL — least-extended mega cap in the group, durable multi-quarter thesis, real room to its actual 52-week high.

🗑️ Cut this run — 14 names, with why

Hard exclusions:
PLTR — 54–55% of revenue is government/defense/intelligence contracts. Excluded under the defense/military rule even though today's catalyst (commercial growth) wasn't itself a contract award.
EZRA (Reliance Global Group) — core business is a conventional insurance agency. Haram exclusion.
CRML (Critical Metals Corp) — catalyst explicitly described in research as riding "military-industrial integration." Excluded regardless of the underlying mining business; also ~80% off its 52-week high with no live breakout.

Faded vs. live IBKR data (search narrative did not hold up):
META — search claimed a Monday surge; IBKR shows price ~26% below its 52-week high and flat on the day.
PYPL — search claimed an upgrade-driven pop; IBKR shows price ~26% off its 13-week high, no live confirmation.
MANH — real 7/29 earnings gap, but IBKR shows the move already gave back ~12% ($213→$187).
HYFM — search touted a 341% surge on an asset sale; IBKR shows the stock actively crashing −20% today. Classic pump-fade.

Stale / unconfirmable / future-dated:
TGT — cited analyst target ($135) is below the current price ($149); no live IBKR tick available to confirm freshness.
CAT — the $915 Morgan Stanley target is from May 1, 2026, not a fresh catalyst.
F (Ford) — cited 7/29 beat, but IBKR shows negligible movement today and price ~19% off recent highs.
CRDO — no fresh catalyst beyond an unconfirmed-date analyst target; IBKR shows price ~29% off its 52-week high.
NNE — IBKR returned no usable volume/52-week context to confirm the claimed move. Insufficient data to pass Gate 1.
WDAY — underlying strength (+31% in July) is over a month old and already priced in; no fresh signal.
ASPN — only catalyst is Q2 earnings scheduled for August 6 — a future-dated event, which Gate 1 explicitly disallows on its own.

How to use this

Pick 1–2 names that feel interesting and say "analyze [TICKER]" for the full deep dive (fundamentals health check, event risk map, stop-limit level). This list is a first filter, not a buy signal. Account is currently $545.12 net liq / $451.65 cash with 1 open position (IQV, 17.1%) — room for 4–6 more at 15–18% sizing each within the 5–7 concurrent position target.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Sector-agnostic discovery — no binary-catalyst plays, no defense/military names. Generated Aug 4, 2026 — Kuwait time.
